title: Pre-Registered EFC Prediction: E_G Statistic from SO x Euclid Cross-Correlation
description:
Pre-Registered EFC Prediction: E_G Statistic from SO x Euclid Cross-Correlation

Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) predicts a specific enhancement of the gravitational slip statistic E_G relative to LambdaCDM, arising from the simultaneous action of mu < 1 (growth suppression) and Sigma > 1 (lensing enhancement) derived self-consistently from a single variational action.

We pre-register the quantitative prediction E_G^EFC / E_G^GR = 1.086 ± 0.012, together with frozen pass/fail criteria, the dataset specification (Simons Observatory LAT x Euclid DR2), and explicit falsification conditions. All numerical values are derived from independently archived, timestamped sources.

This document constitutes a sealed prediction prior to the availability of the targeted observational data. Pre-registration date: 15 April 2026. Expected data: Euclid DR2 + SO cross-correlation, circa 2027-2028.

Governance: No post-hoc adjustment of the predicted value or pass/fail window is permitted. EFC parameters (mu_0 = 0.94, Sigma_0 = 1.05, eta = 1.10) are frozen in the Global Parameter Registry (DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.31876324). Falsification is binding.

Author: Morten Magnusson (Symbiose Research, Sandnes, Norway). ORCID: 0009-0002-4860-5095. Licensed CC-BY-4.0.
